questions.stem: What is the value of i²?
questions.solution: The square of the imaginary unit i is -1. Thus, i² = -1.
questions.explanation: This question tests understanding of a basic property of complex numbers.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to select '0' or '1', which are incorrect because they do not satisfy the fundamental property of i.

questions.stem: What is the square root of -9?
questions.solution: The square root of -9 can be written as √(-1 * 9) = √(-1) * √(9) = i * 3 = 3i.
questions.explanation: This question tests understanding of taking the square root of a negative number using imaginary numbers.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to select '-3', which is the square root of 9 but not -9. Another mistake could be forgetting to include i.
